name: Khan Jehn
summary: At Gelkis Village, Uthek the Wise says Khan Jehn must fall as the Magram grow weak. He asks you to bring the Khan's head back.

sections.title: The Magram Khan
sections.body: At Gelkis Village, Uthek the Wise listens to what the earth tells him. The Magram are growing weak, and their Khan, Jehn, is the one to strike down. Uthek asks you to bring back the Magram Khan's head. He expects you to return as a friend of the Gelkis.

faq.answer: Khan Jehn leads the Magram centaur.

faq.q: Why does Uthek the Wise want Khan Jehn dead?
faq.answer: Uthek says the earth tells him the Magram are growing weak. So he believes the time has come to kill their Khan.
Uthek the Wise is at Gelkis Village in Desolace.
